SELECT R.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, R.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName,
R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS doctorNumber, R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS employeeCode, D.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode, NVL( DP.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '진료과 미정' ) AS deptName,
R.RECEIPT_DATE AS receiptDate, R.TREATMENT_DATE AS treatmentDate,
R.RECEIPT_STATUS AS receiptStatusCode,
CASE R.RECEIPT_STATUS WHEN 'RS102' THEN '접수 처리중' WHEN 'RS103' THEN '진료 대기' WHEN 'RS104' THEN '진료 진행중' WHEN 'RS105' THEN '진료 완료' ELSE NVL( R.RECEIPT_STATUS, '상태 미정' ) END AS receiptStatus,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS orderCode,
R.REGISTER_S AS registerS, R.REGISTER_O AS registerO, R.REGISTER_A AS registerA, R.REGISTER_P AS registerP,
R.SPACE_NUMBER AS spaceNumber, R.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason,
'진료' AS visitType
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER R
LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN MEMBER D ON R.DOCTOR_NUMBER = D.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON R.DOCTOR_NUMBER = E.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT DP ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = DP.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE R.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
ORDER BY NVL( R.TREATMENT_DATE, R.RECEIPT_DATE ) DESC

SELECT R.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, R.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName,
R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS doctorNumber, R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS employeeCode, D.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode, NVL( DP.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '진료과 미정' ) AS deptName,
R.RECEIPT_DATE AS receiptDate, R.TREATMENT_DATE AS treatmentDate,
R.RECEIPT_STATUS AS receiptStatusCode,
CASE R.RECEIPT_STATUS WHEN 'RS102' THEN '접수 처리중' WHEN 'RS103' THEN '진료 대기' WHEN 'RS104' THEN '진료 진행중' WHEN 'RS105' THEN '진료 완료' ELSE NVL( R.RECEIPT_STATUS, '상태 미정' ) END AS receiptStatus,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS orderCode,
R.REGISTER_S AS registerS, R.REGISTER_O AS registerO, R.REGISTER_A AS registerA, R.REGISTER_P AS registerP,
R.SPACE_NUMBER AS spaceNumber, R.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason,
'진료' AS visitType
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER R
LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN MEMBER D ON R.DOCTOR_NUMBER = D.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON R.DOCTOR_NUMBER = E.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT DP ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = DP.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE R.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND R.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}

SELECT M.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName, M.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone, M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER AS residentNumber,
M.PRIMARY_ADDRESS AS primaryAddress, M.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, M.POSTAL_CODE AS zipcode,
M.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus, M.MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus,
TRIM( NVL(M.PRIMARY_ADDRESS, '') || ' ' || NVL(M.DETAILED_ADDRESS, '') ) AS address,
CASE WHEN LENGTH( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ) ) >= 7 AND SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 7, 1 ) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8') THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 7, 1 ) IN ('1', '2', '5', '6') THEN '19' ELSE '20' END || SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 1, 2 ) || '.' || SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 3, 2 ) || '.' || SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 5, 2 ) ELSE NULL END AS birthDate,
CASE WHEN SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 7, 1 ) IN ('1', '3', '5', '7') THEN '남성' WHEN SUBSTR( REPLACE( M.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, '-', '' ), 7, 1 ) IN ('2', '4', '6', '8') THEN '여성' ELSE NULL END AS gender,
CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(M.ACCOUNT_STATUS) = '1' THEN '정상' WHEN TO_CHAR(M.ACCOUNT_STATUS) = '0' THEN '이용 제한' WHEN M.ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(M.ACCOUNT_STATUS) ELSE '상태 미정' END AS whetherToUse
FROM MEMBER M
WHERE M.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}

SELECT *
FROM ( SELECT A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS appointmentNumber, A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS reservationsNumber,
A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber, A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS patientNumber,
M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName, M.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone,
A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS attendingPhysician, A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS employeeCode, D.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
NVL( DP.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '진료과 미정' ) AS deptName,
A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservationStartDate, A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservedAt, A.RESERVATION_END_DATE AS reservationEndDate,
A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationStatus, A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationsStatus,
'APPOINTMENT' AS reservationSource
FROM APPOINTMENT A
LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON A.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN MEMBER D ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = D.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = E.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT DP ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = DP.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE A.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
AND A.RESERVATION_START_DATE >= SYSDATE
AND A.RESERVATION_STATUS IN ('예약확정', '예약', '예약신청')
ORDER BY A.RESERVATION_START_DATE ASC, A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER ASC )
WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT R.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, R.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber,
R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS doctorNumber, R.DOCTOR_NUMBER AS employeeCode,
R.RECEIPT_DATE AS receiptDate, R.TREATMENT_DATE AS treatmentDate, R.RECEIPT_STATUS AS receiptStatus,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS orderCode, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS orederCode,
R.REGISTER_S AS registerS, R.REGISTER_O AS registerO, R.REGISTER_A AS registerA, R.REGISTER_P AS registerP,
R.SPACE_NUMBER AS spaceNumber, R.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER R
WHERE R.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
ORDER BY NVL( R.TREATMENT_DATE, R.RECEIPT_DATE ) DESC
